an10.167:1.1: Tena kho pana samayena Jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo tadah' uposathe sīsaṃ nahāto navaṃ khomayugaṃ nivattho allaṃ kusamuṭṭhiṃ ādāya Bhagavato avidūre ekamantaṃ ṭhito hoti.
an10.167:2.1: Addasā kho Bhagavā Jāṇussoṇiṃ brāhmaṇaṃ tadah' uposathe sīsaṃ nahātaṃ navaṃ khomayugaṃ nivatthaṃ allaṃ kusamuṭṭhiṃ ādāya ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ,
an10.167:2.3: ‘kin nu kho tvaṃ brāhmaṇa tadah' uposathe sīsaṃ nahāto navaṃ khomayugaṃ nivattho allaṃ kusamuṭṭhiṃ ādāya ekamantaṃ ṭhito,
an10.167:2.4: kiṃ nu khv ajja brāhmaṇa brāhmaṇakulassā' ti?
an10.167:3.1: ‘Yathākathaṃ pana brāhmaṇa brāhmaṇānaṃ paccorohaṇī hotī' ti?
an10.167:3.2: ‘Idha bho Gotama brāhmaṇā tadah' uposathe sīsaṃ nahātā navaṃ khomayugaṃ nivatthā allena gomayena paṭhaviṃ opuñjitvā haritehi kusehi pattharitvā antarā ca velaṃ antarā ca agyāgāraṃ seyyaṃ kappenti.
an10.167:3.3: Te taṃ rattiṃ tikkhattuṃ paccuṭṭhāya pañjalikā aggiṃ namassanti
an10.167:3.5: pahutena ca sappitelena navanītena aggiṃ santappenti.
an10.167:3.6: Tassā ca rattiyā accayena paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena brāhmaṇe santappenti.
an10.167:3.7: Evaṃ kho bho Gotama brāhmaṇānaṃ paccorohaṇī hotī' ti.
an10.167:4.1: ‘Aññathā kho brāhmaṇānaṃ paccorohaṇī, aññathā ca pana ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇī hotī' ti.
an10.167:4.2: ‘Yathākathaṃ pana bho Gotama ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇī hoti?
an10.167:4.3: Sādhu me bhavaṃ Gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetu, yathā ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇī hotī' ti.
an10.167:5.1: ‘Tena hi brāhmaṇa suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi, bhāsissāmī' ti.
an10.167:5.2: ‘Evaṃ bho' ti kho Jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo Bhagavato paccassosi.
